subject: Payment sync & credit cap alignment - NovaCare
thread_text:
From: Sara Mendez <sara.mendez@novacare.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: finance@novacare.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment cadence and credit buffer for Redwood services

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the pilot — usage has been smooth. Before we spin up additional capacity for Q4, my finance team needs clarity on payment cadence and a short-term credit buffer to cover onboarding invoices.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood move to Net45 for the first three months of the committed plan (we expect to move to Net30 after)
- Could we have a temporary credit buffer (EUR 200k) while we finalize internal approvals?

We can offer a 1% early-pay discount if Redwood can accept an invoice sweep within 15 days for any month over EUR 150k. Also, for EU VAT: NovaCare will apply reverse-charge for services — we need your VAT registration confirmation and a sample invoice with the reverse-charge line.

Attaching a short spreadsheet with projected invoices.

Best,
Sara
Finance Operations, NovaCare

Attachment: ProjInvoice_Q4_NovaCare.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

-----
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sara Mendez <sara.mendez@novacare.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment cadence and credit buffer for Redwood services

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and the projection. We want to keep NovaCare on a smooth runway while protecting our working capital. Proposal below: 

1) Temporary terms: Net45 for the first two invoice periods (not three) with automated reminder/early-pay sweeps available.
2) Credit buffer: Approve a temporary EUR 200k facility, subject to two items: a signed amendment and receipt of the SOC2 excerpt (we only need the relevant controls page). The buffer will be reduced automatically once outstanding days sales outstanding (DSO) moves below 45 days consistently.
3) Early-pay: We can accept the 1% sweep incentive for invoices > EUR 150k (applies within the first 6 months).
4) VAT: We are registered in Ireland (VAT IE1234567). We will issue invoices with reverse-charge language and sample attached.

I’m looping Marissa (sales ops) and Laura (revenue) to get a quick amendment drafted and confirm the accounting impact. Vivek, can you weigh in on any commercial concessions we should consider for a high growth customer like NovaCare?

Regards,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SampleInvoice_ReverseCharge.pdf (invoice stub)

-----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Sara Mendez <sara.mendez@novacare.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment cadence and credit buffer for Redwood services

Sara — quick note from ops/legal perspective:
- We can draft a short amendment that adds: temporary Net45 for two billing cycles, EUR 200k rolling credit buffer, and the 1% early-pay sweep clause.
- Amendment will include two triggers: (a) buffer reduction when rolling DSO < 45 for 60 days; (b) buffer termination on 30 days delinquency.

Two items we need from NovaCare to proceed today:
1) Confirm the entity that will sign the amendment (legal name + UE/registration number), and
2) Provide SOC2 excerpt (attachment acceptable) or a link to an auditor letter.

If we get both by EOD Friday, I can generate the DocuSign and propose a counter-signed effective date to be the date of signature.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Theo Bianchi <theo@novacare.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: finance@novacare.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment cadence and credit buffer for Redwood services

Team,

Appreciate the flexibility. We can confirm:
- Signing entity: NovaCare Health Ltd, Reg: IE9876543
- SOC2 excerpt attached (we received it from our auditor) — I've pasted the auditor contact if you need direct verification.

One ask: given the credit buffer, can Redwood cap the facility to EUR 200k initial but allow a growth option to EUR 350k if monthly spend exceeds EUR 250k for two consecutive months? That would help as we scale usage quickly.

Also, confirmation that reverse-charge invoices will be acceptable for your billing team is appreciated — we need a sample line item.

Thanks,
Theo Bianchi
CFO, NovaCare

Attachment: NovaCare_SOC2_excerpt.pdf (pdf stub)

-----
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Theo Bianchi <theo@novacare.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment cadence and credit buffer for Redwood services

Theo — that is workable. Final position: 
- Approve initial EUR 200k credit buffer.
- Growth trigger: automatic increase to EUR 350k if NovaCare posts two consecutive months > EUR 250k and on-time payment performance (no >30-day delinquency in the prior 90 days).
- Net45 applies for the first two invoice cycles; Net30 thereafter unless otherwise agreed.
- 1% early-pay sweep available for invoices over EUR 150k for first 6 months.
- VAT: confirm we will invoice with reverse-charge language. Sample invoice attached.

Marissa will issue an amendment to sign (DocuSign link below). Once signed and we receive the SOC2 excerpt (thanks Theo), we’ll enable the buffer and schedule the first invoice sweep. Laura — please queue the accounting entry and set up the receivable ledger with the conditional credit facility. Vivek — this is sales-approved; flag any broader commercial concessions you think are required.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/link/1234-abcd
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/recs/NRV-4821

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth ramp.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Draft_Amendment_Deal_4821.docx (docx stub)
